prompt: Review evals/files/shared-widget-project using the override in evals/files/evidence-policy-screenshot-pair.md. expected_output: The review follows the project's screenshot-pair requirement, does not demand a GIF, notices that the simulated focus treatment does not prove native focus, and marks the focused-state coverage as missing rather than passing it.
assertions: The review accepts the project-declared screenshot pair as the evidence form.
The review does not require a GIF when the project declares the equivalent form.
